candidate.revision: task working tree; record commit and file hashes when a model run occurs

common_inputs.dependencies: existing browser HTML/CSS/JS only; no new dependency
common_inputs.runtime: same browser version, OS, font files, device scale, zoom and reduced-motion preference for each pair; record exact values
common_inputs.design_authority: case input_spec is an existing DESIGN.md; preserve it and use existing component APIs
common_inputs.business_behavior: frozen for each pair; change only explicitly listed presentation defects
common_inputs.assets: system fonts, text and native controls only; no network assets

execution_protocol: Materialize each input_spec once as a minimal app and DESIGN.md; hash these inputs before either run. Use the same byte-identical input files, prompt, assets and state replay in isolated copies for baseline and candidate.

Export the pinned baseline skill without modifying the live checkout. Run baseline and candidate with the same model/provider/version/settings and equivalent clean context. Record actual command, runtime, input/output hashes and missing settings. Never invent outputs or usage metadata.
Use the exact case prompt for both arms. Run existing slop_check and functional assertions independently of screenshot judging. Record selector/state evidence and regressions per arm.

Replay default, focus, disabled, loading/error, interrupted transition and reduced-motion states at each listed viewport. Touch and keyboard runs must exercise the same action outcomes. For unsupported CSS force the baseline branch and check readability.

Capture matching screenshots and interaction traces. Only if human review is run, randomize anonymous A/B artifacts, store the answer key separately, and record reviewer/time/decision/rubric reason plus pre-reveal attestation. Pending cases have no winner or combined score.

cases.prompt: 精修现有 BI 数据看板，保持配色、表格组件和数据 API；刷新指标时不要让数字和按钮跳动。

input_spec.design: flat light, system type, 4px radius; canvas #f5f5f5, ink #202020, primary #275ea8
input_spec.defects: proportional counter widths; loading label shrinks button
input_spec.states: refresh success/error, double refresh, disabled; keyboard and touch

assertions: No glass or new chart library
Test numeral font support and digit-count changes
Stable loading box and readable final value; no invented live metrics

cases.prompt: 保留文档站风格，精修中文和 English API 混排；处理窄屏、长标识符、括号与标点。

input_spec.design: white reading surface, system type, existing text scale and blue links
input_spec.defects: long token overflows; forced keep-all makes mobile unusable
input_spec.text: 中文与 English API（含 punctuation）、版本 v2.0；VeryLongIdentifierWithoutNaturalBreakPoints0123456789
input_spec.states: 320px width, long title, keyboard link focus, enhancement unsupported

assertions: No universal keep-all or typography dependency
Normal wrapping fallback readable and punctuation inspected
Preserve full identifiers and critical text; no silent clipping

cases.prompt: 精修聊天加载与逐字输出，保留发送/停止 API；我向上看历史消息时，不要把我拉回底部。

input_spec.design: existing neutral chat, fixed composer, normal message growth
input_spec.defects: loading replaces composer geometry; unconditional bottom scroll

assertions: Preserve reader scroll intent and stable composer
No per-chunk animated re-entry or noisy live-region announcements

cases.prompt: 保留 terminal 风格和现有组件，只精修按钮、菜单及确认浮层，别换主题。

input_spec.design: black-green terminal, mono is declared, square corners, no shadows or glass
input_spec.defects: action link inside tooltip; focus appears late; submenu closes across gap
input_spec.states: rapid open-close-open, keyboard menu, touch open, destructive confirmation

assertions: No route/apply, bevel, bounce or library replacement
Tooltip holds only supplementary noninteractive text
Immediate focus, existing confirmation preserved; pointer safe zone does not delay keyboard

cases.prompt: 按现有 airy-glass DESIGN.md 精修设置页深浅主题和表面层次；保留色板、支付确认和所有 props。

input_spec.design: existing airy-glass palette is frozen; token roles surface/ink/border/contact-shadow exist
input_spec.defects: transparent text surface unreadable on busy background; shadow transition
input_spec.states: light/dark, unsupported backdrop-filter, reduced-motion, payment pending/error

assertions: No palette engine/catalog edits or fake undo
Opaque token fallback readable; no filter/shadow animation
Use static layers with opacity only when applicable; preserve payment confirmation

execution.notes: This file prepares five controlled comparisons. It is not a generated-output run. Hand-authored mechanism-probe.html is separate authored-fixture runtime evidence.
